name: Run post-incident reviews and track actions in the normal backlog
description: Trigger a root-cause review at a defined threshold, and put the actions arising into the same tracker as ordinary engineering work so closure is visible.
responsible_role: Incident commander for the review; engineering owners for the actions

steps.action: Define the severity threshold and timeframe that trigger a post-incident review.
Hold the review within that timeframe, covering root cause and contributing conditions rather than only the sequence of events.
Raise every action in the normal work tracker with an owner and target date, not in the review document.
Feed root causes back into detection rules and configuration baselines.
Verify restoration succeeded where recovery involved restoring components, rather than assuming it.
Review open actions from prior incidents on a standing cadence so the cycle closes.

implementation_considerations: Actions kept in the review document lapse essentially without exception. Moving them into the normal backlog is the whole remediation.
Blameless framing materially improves the quality of root-cause discussion and costs nothing.
A review threshold set too low produces reviews nobody attends; set it where the learning is real.
typical_duration: Days to define; proven over the following incidents.
prerequisites: A work tracker already used for engineering work

verification_method.how: For incidents at or above the threshold, confirm a review record exists with root cause, and that the actions arising are tracked in the normal backlog with owners and demonstrable closure.

residual_risk_note: A review identifies the cause; it does not guarantee the remediation chosen is sufficient to prevent recurrence.
period_limitation_note: Reviews cannot be held retrospectively for incidents closed during an elapsed period in a way that evidences the control operated then.
notes: The criteria prescribe no review threshold or timeframe. The entity's own threshold governs which incidents require one.
